meta.name: pr-to-video
meta.description: Turn a GitHub pull request (a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' in a checked-out repo) into a code-change explainer video — changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor walkthrough built from the diff, commits, and files: the input is a code change, not a website. Not a product promo (/product-launch-video) or a no-PR topic explainer (/faceless-explainer). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把代码改动变成讲解视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常需要向团队讲解代码改动
copy.tagline_en: Turn code changes into an explainer video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to explain code changes to others

howto.what: 当用户给出 GitHub PR 时,Claude 会读取该 PR 的代码变更,生成分镜脚本并逐帧制作成解说视频(变更日志、新功能、修复或重构),附带配音、音乐和片尾署名。
howto.when: 当用户给出 GitHub PR 链接、owner/repo#编号,或说“这个 PR”时触发;用于代码变更解说,不适用于产品宣传或无 PR 的话题解说。

say.text: 把 octocat/hello-world#42 的代码改动拍成视频
say.note: 会按 PR 变更生成分镜和配音。

say.text: 这是当前仓库的一个 PR,请做成重构解说
say.note: 基于 diff 制作重构讲解视频。

howto.what_en: When the user provides a GitHub PR, Claude reads the code change and produces a frame-by-frame explainer video (changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor walkthrough) built from the diff, commits, and files, with narration, music, and a credits close.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user provides a GitHub PR URL, an owner/repo#N reference, or says 'this PR' in a checked-out repo. It is for code-change explainers, not product promos or no-PR topic explainers.

say_en.text: Make an explainer video from this PR link: https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/123
say_en.note: Claude reads the PR's diff and produces the video.

say_en.text: Turn the changes in octocat/hello-world#42 into a video
say_en.note: It creates a storyboard and narration from the PR.

say_en.text: This is a PR in the current repo — make a refactor walkthrough
say_en.note: Builds the video from the diff.
